item.title: Alexandrite: Colour Changes with the Light
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Alexandrite is a colour-change variety of chrysoberyl. It can appear bluish green in daylight and purplish red under incandescent light.
EXIMUTC view: request views under both light sources before assessing a colour-change gem.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/alexandrite
